messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

message.content:
The best time to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for, but most travelers find the shoulder seasons—**April through June** and **September through November**—to be ideal.

| Season | What to Expect |
|--------|----------------|
| **Peak (Dec–Feb)** | Warmest temperatures (80–85 °F), higher humidity, and the highest crowds and prices. Great for winter sun seekers. |
| **Shoulder (Apr–Jun & Sep–Nov)** | Pleasant temperatures (70–80 °F), lower humidity, fewer tourists, and better deals on flights and accommodations. |
| **Low (Jul–Aug)** | Warmest days (up to 90 °F) and the busiest tourist season; also the most expensive. |

If you prefer mild weather with fewer crowds and more affordable rates, aim for late spring or early fall. If you’re after the absolute warmest conditions and don’t mind the crowds, mid‑winter is your best bet.
